描述_EN: chesterman has used the wood-grain to represent the sea-water caves and the rock strata of the cliffs above, which gives the composition three-dimensionality and sense of movement. landing place by merlyn chesterman is a woodblock print. artist merlyn chesterman became interested in woodcuts during a visit to china where she saw them being used in windows instead of glass. the artist has also shaped the blcok show silhouette outlines of more birds and cliffs. the shaped edge reinforces the two-dimensions of the woodblock surface. the block has been cut into in places to represent white sea-gulls against the darker cliff backdrop.
描述_ZN: 画家用木纹来表现海水的洞穴和上面悬崖的岩层，这使构图具有立体感和运动感。 梅林-克瑟曼的《登陆点》是一幅木版画。 艺术家Merlyn chesterman在访问中国时对木刻产生了兴趣，在那里她看到木刻被用于窗户而不是玻璃。 艺术家还对木块进行了塑形，以显示更多鸟类和悬崖的剪影轮廓。 异形的边缘加强了木版画表面的二维性。 这块木板在一些地方被切割成了白色的海鸥，代表着黑暗的悬崖背景。
